auction_targets.name: Naman Dhir
auction_targets.target_rationale: 182.4 pressure strike rate with exceptional boundary acceleration in overs 11-16. Elite spin-hitting capability.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Provides flexible middle-order velocity against high-quality spin without losing momentum.

auction_targets.name: Rasikh Salam
auction_targets.target_rationale: High-volume wicket-taker at the death (12.6 strike rate). Excellent variations and wide yorker execution.
auction_targets.rr_fit: High-ROI domestic Indian pace target to complement Sandeep Sharma and overseas seamers.

auction_targets.name: Mitchell Santner
auction_targets.target_rationale: Sub-7.50 economy rate in pressure overs. Consistently starves opposition boundaries and creates pressure wickets.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Elite spin choke weapon for Sawai Mansingh Stadium pitch conditions.

auction_targets.name: Akeal Hosein
auction_targets.target_rationale: Rank #3 overall bowler under pressure. 7.15 economy in overs 1-6 when win probability swings violently.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Immediate powerplay wicket and run-suppression asset that frees up death bowlers.

auction_targets.name: Sediqullah Atal
auction_targets.target_rationale: Remarkable 54.2 average under high pressure with +28.4 SR lift. Top-order stability without strike-rate compromise.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Left-handed top-order option for anchor/accelerator role in high-leverage run chases.

auction_targets.name: Shreyas Iyer
auction_targets.target_rationale: Rank #1 overall batter. +42.6 strike rate lift in critical leverage moments with an IPL winning captain pedigree.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Elite marquee acquisition to solidify the #3/#4 spot and provide tactical match awareness.

auction_targets.name: Matheesha Pathirana
auction_targets.target_rationale: Lowest strike rate per wicket in death overs (13.5). Unique release trajectory makes boundaries virtually impossible.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Match-winning death overs enforcer to shut down opposing finishers.

auction_targets.name: Tim David
auction_targets.target_rationale: 189.9 strike rate across 645 pressure balls. Elite six-hitting frequency in overs 18-20 when 15+ RPO is required.
auction_targets.rr_fit: World-class lower-order muscle to win matches from seemingly impossible target deficits.

auction_targets.name: Tristan Stubbs
auction_targets.target_rationale: +50.5 SR lift under pressure. Exceptional against both high pace and defensive spin wide yorkers.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Dynamic middle-order finisher capable of keeping the required rate under control through 360-degree ground coverage.

auction_targets.name: Donovan Ferreira
auction_targets.target_rationale: 192.1 strike rate under pressure with a staggering +63.7 delta lift. Capable of instant boundary execution from ball one.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Familiarity with the Rajasthan Royals dugout; premium low-cost retention / repurchase target.

auction_targets.name: Sameer Rizvi
auction_targets.target_rationale: +62.0 SR elevation under match pressure. Ruthless down-the-ground attacking game against wrist and finger spinners.
auction_targets.rr_fit: High-ROI uncapped Indian batting talent with huge tactical growth potential for Jaipur conditions.

auction_targets.name: Maheesh Theekshana
auction_targets.target_rationale: Outstanding 7.86 pressure economy rate over 553 balls. Masters both new-ball powerplay and defensive death-overs bowling.
auction_targets.rr_fit: Provides an elite multi-phase spinner to partner Ravichandran Ashwin or lock down middle overs.

auction_targets.name: Spencer Johnson
auction_targets.target_rationale: Clocking 145kph+ with sharp bounce and angle across right-handers. Suppresses economy by +0.89 below baseline.

auction_targets.name: Michael Bracewell
auction_targets.target_rationale: Staggering 7.31 economy rate in high-leverage overs combined with handy left-handed crunch hitting.
